name: Futurola x Tyson | King Size Terp-Infused Blunt Cone | The Toad
description: Mike Tyson’s partnered with Futurola to create these unique tobacco-free blunt wrap cones. Each blunt wrap is pre-rolled and sealed with a Futurola filter tip which is essential for keeping the shape and catching crumbs. The wraps are infused with natural terpenes to create Mike’s favorite blend: the Toad.
